claim: Let \(ABC\) be an equilateral triangle with circumcenter \(O\) and circumradius \(R>0\). For every point \(P\in\mathbb{R}^2\), write \(\rho=OP\). Then \[|R-\rho|+2\sqrt{R^2+R\rho+\rho^2}\le PA+PB+PC\le R+\rho+2\sqrt{R^2-R\rho+\rho^2}.\] If \(\rho>0\), equality in the lower bound holds exactly when \(P\) lies on one of the three rays from \(O\) through a vertex, and equality in the upper bound holds exactly when \(P\) lies on one of the three opposite rays, equivalently on a ray from \(O\) through a side midpoint. For \(\rho=0\), both bounds equal \(3R\).
scientific_limitations: The exact envelope is proved only for three foci at the vertices of an equilateral triangle.
Historical novelty is supported by targeted database and primary-source comparison but cannot be made exhaustive across all older polyellipse terminology.
title: Exact radial envelope for the equilateral three-focus distance sum
